prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a parking lot collision in Houston, Texas, and has concussion. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1308; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Can you confirm you understand this call is being recorded?

A: Yes, I understand.

Q: Please describe where you were when the collision happened.

A: I was in the parking lot of a grocery store in Houston. I was backing out of a space near the front entrance.

Q: What time of day was it, and what were the weather and lighting conditions?

A: It was in the afternoon. It was clear, and the lot was fairly busy but the lighting was good.

Q: Tell me what happened when the other vehicle came into the picture.

A: I checked my mirrors and didn't see anything, so I started backing slowly. A vehicle came down the aisle and I think I braked as soon as I saw it, but we still made contact on the rear quarter panel of my car.

Q: Did you feel any impact inside your vehicle?

A: Yes, my head snapped forward and then back against the headrest. The airbag did not deploy.

Q: Did you seek medical attention after the collision?

A: I did. I drove myself to urgent care because I had a headache, dizziness, and I felt confused for a while. They said it looked like a concussion.

Q: Have you experienced any symptoms since then?

A: Yes, I still get headaches most days, and bright lights bother me. I have trouble concentrating at work, and I have been resting more than usual.

Q: Are you currently under the care of a physician or any other provider?

A: Yes, I have a follow-up with my primary care doctor next week and I was referred to a neurologist.

Q: Is there anything you would like to add or correct in your statement?

A: No, I think that covers it. I just want my vehicle repaired and to get my health back to normal.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.

A: Thank you.
